description: Country-by-country initial police staffing, fleet quantities, replacement values, and crime baselines. World Bank latest-available population and homicide observations are preserved by country and year. All non-homicide categories, staffing levels and vehicle inventories are explicit game estimates.

population.observationPolicy: Latest available non-empty observation per country; each row preserves its year.

homicide.observationPolicy: Latest available non-empty homicide rate per country; different countries may have different observation years.

sources.economy: economy_global_profiles_v1.json (existing local baseline; GDP per-capita and income stress are used only as model inputs)
sources.urbanization: economy_global_profiles_v1.json populationValues.urbanization_rate, otherwise explicit modeled fallback

gameRules.fleetSizing: Opening vehicle inventories preserve each country's modeled baseline total and its previous Tier 9-15 specialist/advanced vehicle counts; lower-tier allocations are adjusted to country context. Planning target: 1 vehicle per 18 target officers. Both opening fleet counts and the planning target are game estimates, not observed official rosters.
gameRules.baselinePersonnelFormula: population × estimated police staffing rate per 100000; rate is a game-policy baseline, not observed staffing
gameRules.nonHomicideCrimePolicy: Modeled rates are starting gameplay intensity assumptions, not published country crime rates
gameRules.inheritedAssets: Initial fleets are seeded as already-owned starting assets; no purchase debit is applied for opening inventory. All subsequent purchases and hiring are charged to Finance.
gameRules.countryOperatingProfile: City, highway, rural, border, industrial and coastal shares are modeled game weights derived from country urbanization, ocean access and economy inputs; they are not surveyed road-network measurements.
gameRules.policeStaffingPlanningTarget: At least 150 officers per 100,000 residents or 110% of a country's modeled opening staffing rate, whichever is higher; gameplay-balancing target only, not a claim about actual police staffing or a universal international standard.
gameRules.facilityAndTrainingTargets: Gameplay targets: station 2, patrol 2, dispatch 2, forensics 2, border 1, communications 2, academy 3, cyber 1, emergency 2, department 2; training target Level 3. These are strategy-game capacity goals, not official real-world standards.
gameRules.countryContextModel: Country profiles use the existing countries.json geography and city directory when available, plus model inputs for urbanisation and economy. Mountain/coastal/industrial/road indices are contextual game proxies and are not measured road/terrain surveys.
gameRules.countryCrimeRates: Crime rates vary by country in the baseline. Except for explicitly sourced observed indicators, category rates are modelled gameplay estimates, not official country crime statistics.
